product.description:
Designed for the ultimate pro-style kitchen, Tidal II wall hood features optional dual 1300-CFM PowerWave™ blowers, Zephyr Connect capabilities, and professional baffle filters. The next wave of the future, Tidal II is equipped with LumiLight LED Lighting and 6-Speed Proximity Touch Controls.

Features:

  • Blower outputs up to 700 CFM to keep your kitchen free of cooking fumes and odors
  • Electronic touch controls allow you to easily set the power level of your range hood
  • LumiLight LED lights illuminate cooking surface
  • Compatible with Zephyr Connect App
  • High-airflow baffle filters are dishwasher safe and ensure a lifetime of exceptional performance
  • CleanAir Function powers the hood on every four hours for 10 minutes to refresh the cooking area
  • This hood has the ability to vent either out the top or out the back
  • ADA compliant with optional remote
  • Covered under a 1 year labor and 3 year parts warranty

Product Technologies:

  • Airflow Control Technology™ (ACT™): Airflow Control Technology or ACT™ is an exclusive technology that gives installers the ability to set the maximum CFM levels to meet local code requirements.
  • LumiLight LED Lighting: LumiLight LED lights are eco-friendly and built to last with a lifetime of more than 25,000 hours. The multi-level dimmable LEDs require less energy than traditional halogen lights, are cool to the touch, and provide uniform light distribution.
  • Optional Ductless Recirculating Kit: Ductless recirculating kit used when venting air outside your home is not possible. Smoke and odors pass through charcoal filters allowing purified air to be reintroduced into the kitchen

Specifications:

  • CFM: 200, 290, 700
  • Sones: 0.8, 6
  • Nominal Width: 48"
  • Width: 47-7/8"
  • Height: 18"
  • Depth: 24"
  • Duct Size: 10" Round, 3-1/4" x 10", 8" Round
  • Ceiling Height: 96" - 144"
  • ADA Approved: Yes (with optional remote)
  • Amperage: 5A
  • Voltage: 120V
  • Wattage: 600W
